1.summary: The plan points the right way, but the week went somewhere else. You are publishing steadily, yet none of the 3 planned items has shipped. The 3 videos that did go out are market commentary and a mindset Short, which your data says are your weakest formats (10, 12 and 18 views so far). The planned items are practical n8n builds, your strongest type, and all 3 are still at 'writing'. The week ends on Tuesday 24 Nov.
